spark_open.description: The creature is a quadrupedal, bear-shaped animal shown in right-facing profile against a plain light background. Its head, neck, chest, underbelly, tail and paws are covered in dense brown fur, while its back, sides, shoulders, hips and most of its legs are covered by a glossy, dark brown to black segmented exoskeleton that looks like beetle armor. It has a single long, smooth, curved black horn arising from the forehead and arching forward over the head, small rounded furry ears, four stout clawed paws on the ground, and a short bushy furry tail protruding from under the rear armor. The underbelly is pale tan with rows of small circular openings along the side.

meta_spark.description: A large quadrupedal creature shown in right-facing profile with the furry head, ears, muzzle, underside, paws with claws, and small rear tufted tail of a brown bear, merged with a glossy dark brown segmented exoskeleton covering the entire back, sides, and legs. A single long, smooth, black curved horn with a small barb on its underside rises from the center of the forehead and arches forward over the head. The back armor is divided into overlapping plates with visible scratches and highlights, the lower side of the torso shows rows of round breathing holes, and the legs are sheathed in jointed armored segments ending in furry bear feet.
